proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Public Report on Lobbying Activities
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing IBM's lobbying policies, direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots payments, recipients, and oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Public Report on Congruency in China Business Operations and ESG Activities
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party review of whether IBM's China business aligns with its ESG commitments and Human Rights Statement, and board plans to mitigate misalignment.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board steps to permit shareholders to act by written consent with the minimum votes needed at a fully attended meeting.
proposals.evidence: THEREFORE, THE BOARD RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting a Public Report on Climate Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual analysis and report on whether IBM's direct and indirect lobbying aligns with its net-zero 2030 emissions target.
proposals.evidence: THEREFORE, THE BOARD RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Requesting the Adoption of Greenhouse Gas Emissions Targets
proposals.proponent: Green Century Capital Management, Inc., on behalf of the Green Century Equity Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests independently verified short-, medium- and long-term science-based emissions targets covering full value chain, achieving net zero by 2050.
proposals.evidence: YOUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THIS PROPOSAL.
